cohort: 96 primiparous women 50-70 days postpartum, 24 of whom underwent cesarean delivery and 72 of whom had a vaginal birth
finding: Pelvic floor muscle strength did not differ between primiparous women based on mode of delivery at 50-70 days postpartum.
mod_finding: While there was no overall difference in pelvic floor muscle strength by mode of delivery, women who had vaginal births and higher education levels or who performed perineal exercises during pregnancy had greater pelvic floor muscle strength.
